title: Born next to the Army's first nuclear test reactor

tellings.quote: reactor that the Army had spun up uh and

plain: A scientist named John Blitch, who worked for DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, says he was born near Idaho Falls, Idaho, right next to the first nuclear test reactor the US Army had set up. He tells it himself as part of his own life story, which takes in the 1950s and early 1960s and leads up to his account of being taken by an alien.
